main_body: A hedge or bush slab: a leafy green top band over a darker foliage front face
top_band: Mid and light mottled green, rows 1-5, ending in a pale lime front-edge line at row 6
evidence: Down the middle column, rows 1-5 are a lighter mottled green top surface. Row 6 is a distinct pale lime front-edge line. Rows 7-8 are dark green, which reads as shade under the edge. Rows 9-13 are darker clumped foliage forming the front face. The top is several rows tall and clearly separate from the front, so this is a valid 3/4 organic form. There is no recessed front, but that is not expected for foliage.

style.evidence: Each material has about 4 green steps, against 5-6 for the reference stall and well. The outline is dark green, so it reads as material tone and not as a black sticker line. The top texture is a blocky checker-style mosaic of pixels, not shaped leaf clumps. The front has dark clump spots, but the whole piece is simple and a uniform strip. Next to the detailed reference props it looks thinner and lower in information per tile.
